name: 12/8 roadhouse shuffle
desc: Slow-blues 12/8 shuffle: ride cymbal swinging the triplet grid with a ding-ding-DING accent, kick anchoring beats one and three (dotted), rimshot cracking the backbeat — the Chicago roadhouse pocket of a Jimmy Reed record. Peak swaps rim for full snare and rolls the turnaround.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.8).shape(.3), s("rd ~ rd rd ~ rd rd ~ rd rd ~ rd").gain(${ride}*.7).hpf(3000)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.4), s("~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.25), s("rd ~ rd rd ~ rd rd ~ rd rd ~ rd").gain("[.36 .24 .3]*4").hpf(2600), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ ~ ~ [sd sd sd]> ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.55)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
